title: Astrophysical Signature and Optical Appearance of Weyl--Corrected Einstein--Maxwell Black Holes
summary: In this work, we investigate the physics of charged black holes modified by Weyl corrections, which emerge from the non-minimal coupling between spacetime curvature and electromagnetism. We begin by revisiting the thermodynamics of these systems, deriving the Hawking temperature, Wald entropy, and heat capacity to examine how the Weyl correction parameter reshapes the landscape of thermal stability and phase transitions.
